thread:
Rina Park: Dropping the near-final launch post draft here: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch-final-v3
Carlos Mendes: Quick read. Two action items: tighten the hero benchmark language and confirm webinar CTA+UTM mapping. :mag_right:
Hana Ito: On benchmarks: prefer \"validated in our tests\" instead of \"proven\" (legal asked us to avoid absolute claims). Also add the run date and model in parentheses in the hero.
Rina Park: Suggested hero line: \"Up to 48% lower per-query cost on real docs-search tests (mosaic-13b, 2026-03-18) — validated in our tests.\" Thoughts?
Leo W: That reads well. For the bench section, link to methods with an asterisk: \"*Methods and run details here.\" Also include hardware note: A100-40GB.
Carlos Mendes: Good call. UTM pattern proposal: campaign=launch-q2a, source=blog, medium=organic, content=hero|bench. Example hero link: `?utm_campaign=launch-q2a&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=hero`
Hana Ito: Ops requested slightly different naming: use `launch-q2` (no letter) so it matches other campaigns. They want content=hero-webinar for hero->webinar mapping.
Rina Park: Let's go with ops' naming to avoid mismatches. Final UTM example: `?utm_campaign=launch-q2&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=hero-webinar`
Katherine (Legal): Quick redline: replace any occurrence of \"guarantees\" with \"aims to\" and change \"best\" to \"validated in our tests\". Also remove any customer-identifiable claims unless we have explicit permission.
Rina Park: Got it, I'll apply the redlines and push a new draft link once done.
Carlos Mendes: Routing for webinar registrants: prefer SDR-EMEA (tag: SDR_EMEA) for first 72 hours for EU/UK region_hint, otherwise SDR-NorthAmerica. After 72h, reroute to SDR_Backlog. Ops: can you confirm webhook fields?
IntegrationsBot: webhook schema validation: OK. Required fields present: `email`, `first_name`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_content`, `region_hint`, `lead_tag`. Recommend adding `lead_ttl_hours:72` for upstream routing logic.
Leo W: Accessibility check: hero chart alt text should be \"Cost vs latency for mosaic-13b on docs-search workload, A100-40GB\" and ensure contrast ratio meets AA.
Hana Ito: Also request that the hero CTA copy be explicit: \"View benchmarks & register\" (not \"Try now\"). Secondary CTA: \"See full methods\".
Rina Park: I'll update CTAs and alt text, then post v4 of the draft. Can folks do a final read by 3:30pm PT? aiming to lock assets by 4:15pm.
Carlos Mendes: I'll finish the UTM CSV and drop in #ops by 2:45pm PT.
Katherine (Legal): I can sign off by 4:00pm PT if there are no further substantive claims added.
IntegrationsBot: Staging webhook test scheduled for 21:30 PT. Ops will run a sample payload at 21:20 PT for final verification.
Rina Park: Thanks everyone. Leaving thread open for the v4 link and final signoffs. :rocket:
